title: The team votes on a Plan's candidate dates and times, and the best option shows first

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; owner ask 2026-11-24 17:35Z: AI meeting and date management so everyone can brainstorm the best date and time)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-24: Pencil it in already holds up to three candidate dates per Plan (option_group), but only the person who pencilled them can see which one works; co-hosts and collaborators have no way to say yes, if need be or no. Best practice (Doodle, When2meet, Calendly polls): each person marks every option, the options rank by yes then if-need-be, ties break on who must attend. Fix: a votes table keyed by entry and person, rankTimeOptions, a Find a time panel on the Plan and in the thread; a vote notifies the Plan owner through the LIVE-2526 Inbox.

DONE 2026-11-24: public.space_calendar_time_votes (migration 20270346400000, one yes / if need be / no per person per candidate date, team reads, member writes own, email votes server-only), rankTimeOptions (yes, then yes+maybe, then fewest no, a lead's no sinks the option), the Find a time panel in the Plan drawer, and a plain notifications row to the Plan's lead on each answer.

verify.note: Passes once a migration creates the votes table and lib/calendar exports rankTimeOptions.
